persons.name: Bora Özkent
persons.digest: In this video Bora Özkent sums up the selloff as "growth without patience": AI infrastructure growth news keeps coming while the market is impatient about negative cash flow. **Alphabet** fell about 12.6% in a day; cloud growth hit 103% but ad growth slowed to 12%. Bora finds the reaction excessive and sees buying near the 200-day average as sensible, though he does not invest in it himself. At **Amazon**, AWS grew 39.3% and free cash flow was -$42.4B; Bora remains a long-term Amazon investor. He sees a management problem at **Intel**, expects a correction in software and cybersecurity via **ServiceNow** and **Fortinet**, and likes **Reddit** but does not want to catch a falling knife. **Bitcoin** held at 78,534 despite the Binance attack. On macro, Q3 growth was 3.4% and PCE 3.6%; oil and the November 3 elections stand out as risks.

items.title: Piyasalar Derin Panikte !
items.summary: According to Bora Özkent the main theme is "growth without patience": strong AI infrastructure growth continues but the market will not tolerate negative cash flow and is using earnings as a pretext for rotation. Alphabet fell 12.64% in a day, losing about $500B of value; cloud growth was 103%, ad growth slowed from 19.1% and 16.8% in earlier quarters to 12%, and free cash flow is negative. Bora finds the reaction excessive and says buying when it touches the 200-day average usually pays off, but says he does not plan to invest in Alphabet and argues the CEO should go. At Amazon, AWS grew 39.3%, management expects roughly 40% growth for the next two years, free cash flow was -$42.4B and 2026 capex is about $200B; Bora stays in because his thesis has not changed. Intel's earnings were in line but Q4 guidance was about $1B weak; Bora reads this as a management and supply problem, not weak demand. Reddit fell 18% (revenue growth 53%); users are declining because of Google traffic, and Bora wants to buy but the falling trend scares him. ServiceNow fell about 27% and Fortinet 20%; Bora calls software services "dead business" and expects rationalization in cybersecurity. Binance suffered an attack of about $6.36B, and Bitcoin lost 80,000 but held at 78,534. On macro, Q3 growth rose from 2.2% to 3.4%, September PCE was 3.6%; Brent is above $100-110, and the November 3 elections and the Apple earnings are the things to watch.

assets.note: Cloud grew 103% while ad growth slowed to 12%; Bora thinks the reaction is excessive and buying at the 200-day average is sensible, but he does not invest.
